component.name: My Role in the Grand Scheme
component.summary: A sort of Clue-inspired role-playing game

description.p: You're a newly licensed private investigator. Gather clues, interrogate suspects, search crime scenes and connect the pieces (and perhaps defend yourself). Every case is a puzzle, and every conclusion is yours to make.
Take cases. Get paid. Stay alive. Repeat.
Build your investigation board, establish relationships between people, places and evidence, and uncover the madness and the corruption hiding beneath the city's surface.
There won’t be any easy answers.
P.S. Keep in mind that the game is VERY difficult, the tutorial is minimal, and you'll have to learn as you go (everything is intentional).
